pr_title: py/stream.c: use mp_obj_get_type to avoid segfault

issue_context.title: segfault when argument to btree.open() is not an object
comments:
Nice write-up, I like the headings ;-).

> either before mp_get_stream_raise() call in mod_btree_open or inside of the mp_get_stream_raise().

So, now feel free to wear maintainer's hat and decide which of these two are better, preferably with arguments.
thanks :)

I've made `mp_get_stream_raise` similar to `mp_get_buffer[_raise]`.
Thanks too, but is that the only argument? Doing something like someone/something else isn't always a good argument on its own. Good arguments would come from considering "if I make a one, or another change, what outcomes of it will be?". In either case, the commit message isn't good - it's unclear how switching one for another avoids segfault. The description why it helps, and "made mp_get_stream_raise similar to mp_get_buffer[_raise]." should really be in the commit message.
Ok, you're right. Is it good now?
Generally, next expected step was to analyze all call sites of mp_get_stream_raise() and make sure it's not on hot paths (like, in loops). Well, this is small useful change, so I'm merging it as is. Thanks for contribution!

review_comments: Please avoid such (i.e. unrelated) changes in future patches.
